description: Defines an abstract class for legacy password hashing framework in Drupal, implementing password encoding, verification, and rehashing logic.

classes.name: PhpassHashedPasswordBase
classes.description: Abstract class implementing legacy password hashing with configurable iteration counts and base64 encoding.

methods.name: base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes bytes into a base64 string using a custom character set.

methods.name: enforceLog2Boundaries
methods.description: Ensures the log2 iteration count is within predefined min and max bounds.

methods.name: crypt
methods.description: Hashes a password with a specified algorithm, salt, and iteration count, returning a truncated hash string.

methods.name: getCountLog2
methods.description: Extracts the log2 iteration count from a stored hash setting.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Delegates password hashing to the core PasswordInterface implementation.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies a password against a stored hash, supporting different hash types and legacy formats.

methods.name: needsRehash
methods.description: Determines if a stored hash needs to be rehashed based on current standards.
